DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約は四名様ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your reservation is for four people, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 席で飲むのは四人ですが、写真だけ撮りに一人来ます。席を使わなければ人数へ入れなくてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 席利用四人と撮影来場一人の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: Four of us will drink at the table, but one more person will come just to take photographs. If they don't use a seat, can they be excluded from the count?
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how four seated users and one visiting photographer should be counted.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 来店する方と利用予定を確認します。その方は店内へ入って撮影する予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check who will visit and their intended use. Does that person plan to enter the shop to take photos?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。入口の外だけではありません。五人が来ることをまだ伝えていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 店内に五人が来る予定を未申告だったと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, not only outside the entrance. I hadn't yet told you five people would come.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you had not reported the plan for five people to enter the shop.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 撮影と来店の扱いを担当へ確認します。四名の席へ勝手に五人で入らずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check with the person responsible about photography and visiting. Please wait rather than bring five people into a four-person seating area yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。写真を撮る人は飲食しない予定ですが、来店しない人とは違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 非飲食者と非来場者は違うと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. The photographer doesn't plan to eat or drink, but that differs from not visiting at all.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge in Japanese that someone not eating or drinking differs from someone not visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その予定で確認します。撮影ができない場合、予約はどうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check on that basis. If photography isn't permitted, what would you like to do with the booking?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 四人の飲食はそのまま希望します。写真は外の別の場所で撮るよう友人へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 撮影不可でも四人の飲食予約を維持したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: We still want dining for the four. I'll discuss with my friend taking photos at another place outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to keep the four-person dining reservation even if photography is unavailable.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この場面では店内撮影はお受けできません。四名の利用は予約どおりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: In this scenario, we cannot accept indoor photography. The four-person visit remains as booked.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 承知しました。撮影担当には店内へ入らないよう連絡し、四人だけで来店します。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不可結果に応じ外撮影と四人来店へ予定を変える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll tell the photographer not to enter the shop and only four of us will visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Change the plan in Japanese to outside photography and a four-person visit based on the refusal.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 四名様でお待ちします。変更があれば事前にご連絡ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll expect four people. Please contact us beforehand if anything changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 待ち合わせの場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a meeting place?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人と三十分後に待つと決めました。でも私が入る時と、友人が入る時で五分違いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三十分の起点が双方で五分違うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My friend and I agreed to meet after thirty minutes. But we entered five minutes apart.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your starting points for thirty minutes differ by five minutes.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 三十分を数え始める時点が違うのですね。具体的な時刻は決めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you started counting thirty minutes at different times. Have you decided a specific clock time?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 決めていません。各自が入った時から三十分だと、同時にならないかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 具体的集合時刻は未設定だと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. Thirty minutes after each of us entered might not be the same time.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that no specific meeting time has been set.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 館内の共通の時計で、集合時刻を決められます。着替えの時間も含める予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can set a meeting time using the shared clock here. Do you plan to include changing time too?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 含めます。風呂から出る時刻でなく、着替えて休憩場所へ着く時刻を合わせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 着替えを含む休憩場所への到着時刻を合わせたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'd like to match the time we arrive dressed at the rest area, not the time we leave the baths.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to agree on arrival at the rest area including changing time.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 休憩場所はこちらです。今の時計を確認し、友人へ具体的な時刻を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: The rest area is here. Check the clock now and tell your friend a specific time.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二時四十分と伝えます。どちらか遅れても、相手の浴室へ探しに行く方法にはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 共通時計の時刻を決め相手の浴室へ探しに行かないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll say two forty. Even if one of us is late, we won't go into the other's bathing area to search.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Set a shared clock time and say in Japanese that you will not search the other person's bathing area.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 遅れた場合の連絡や待つ場所も、お二人で決めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also decide together how to contact each other if late and where to wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。休憩場所で待つと合わせます。三十分後という別々の数え方は使わないことにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相対時間でなく絶対時刻と固定場所で合意する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. We'll agree to wait at the rest area. We won't use separate interpretations of “thirty minutes later.”
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Agree in Japanese on an exact clock time and fixed place instead of relative time.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 場所はこちらです。お二人で時刻をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: The place is here. Please confirm the time together.

DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日はどの班の指示を受けましたか。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which team gave you instructions today?

DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日と同じ札を持っています。朝礼で別の班名が聞こえましたが、札があるので前の場所へ行こうとしました。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旧担当札と聞き取れない新班名を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have the same tag as yesterday. I heard a different team name at the morning meeting, but because I had the tag, I was going to the old place.
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese your old assignment tag and the new team name you did not catch clearly.

DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 前日の札だけで今日の担当を決めないでください。当日の指示は確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't determine today's assignment from yesterday's tag alone. Have you confirmed today's instructions?

DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: できていません。聞こえた班名だけで移るのも違うと思い、ここへ戻りました。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 当日担当は未確認なので戻ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I thought moving based only on the team name I heard wasn't right either, so I came back here.
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that today's assignment is unconfirmed and you returned.

DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 責任者へ担当と作業範囲を確認します。道具はどこに置いていますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the assignment and work scope with the supervisor. Where have you put your tools?

DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 前の持場には運ばず、指定の置場にあります。札も自分で書き換えていません。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 道具は未搬入で札も変更していないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-06.translation: At the designated storage place, not moved to the old station. I haven't rewritten the tag myself either.
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the tools have not been brought into the work area and the tag is unchanged.

DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのまま待ってください。今日の作業で立ち入れる範囲も、担当と一緒に説明を受けましょう。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-07.translation: Wait as you are. Let's hear the explanation of where you may enter for today's work together with the person responsible.

DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。班名だけ決めて先に入らず、入口と立入範囲を聞いてから道具を運びます。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 担当だけでなく入口と立入範囲を確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't just decide the team name and enter first; I'll hear about the entrance and permitted area before carrying tools.
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to confirm the entrance and permitted area as well as the assignment.

DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 責任者がこちらで説明します。昨日の札は見比べるために見せてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-09.translation: The supervisor will explain here. Please show yesterday's tag for comparison.

DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。旧札は当日の許可として使わず、今日の担当と範囲を確認してから動きます。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当日指示を受けるまで作業開始を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I won't use the old tag as today's permission. I'll check today's assignment and scope before moving.
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait to begin work until receiving today's instructions.

DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認後に新しい指示を受けてください。今は作業を始めずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-001-SHARED-11.translation: Receive the new instructions after confirmation. Don't start work now; please wait.

DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 朝礼の注意事項で、確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you'd like to check about the morning meeting's precautions?

DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 開口部に覆いがあるのか、まだないのか、通訳の最後が聞き取れませんでした。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通訳の否定が不明で開口部状態を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-02.translation: I couldn't catch the end of the interpretation about whether the opening has a cover or still doesn't.
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the negative wording in interpretation was unclear and you want to check the opening's condition.

DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらだと決めて現場へ進まず、原の指示を確認しましょう。いまどこにいますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-03.translation: Let's confirm the original instruction without deciding either way and proceeding to the site. Where are you now?

DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 集合場所です。自分で覆いを持ち上げて確かめるために現場へ行ったわけではありません。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-04.hintJa: 集合場所にいて自己確認のため立入していないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-04.translation: At the assembly point. I haven't gone to the site to lift a cover and check for myself.
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are at the assembly point and have not entered to check independently.

DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 責任者に確認します。通訳してくれた方にも、否定の部分を省かず説明してもらいます。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ask the supervisor. We'll also have the interpreter explain without omitting the negative part.

DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。「ある」と「ない」の違いを、図の対象箇所と一緒に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-06.hintJa: 否定を省かず対象図と併せた説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-06.translation: Please. I'd like to check the difference between “there is” and “there isn't” together with the relevant part of the drawing.
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for an explanation retaining the negative wording and referring to the target on the drawing.

DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 対象箇所はこの図の東側です。状態と近づかない範囲は責任者から説明します。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-07.translation: The target is the east side of this drawing. The supervisor will explain its condition and the area to stay away from.

DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 東側ですね。別の開口部の話と混ぜず、確認結果を待ちます。同僚へあると先に伝えません。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-08.hintJa: 東側の対象を特定し未確認情報を同僚へ伝えないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-08.translation: The east side, then. I won't mix it up with another opening and will wait for confirmation. I won't first tell colleagues it has a cover.
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Identify the eastern target and say in Japanese that you will not pass unconfirmed information to colleagues.

DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 責任者が説明するまで、そこへ入る作業は始めないでください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-09.translation: Don't start work entering there before the supervisor explains.

DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。対象と否定を確認し、担当者の説明を聞いてから自分の作業範囲を復唱します。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-10.hintJa: 責任者説明後に範囲を復唱してから作業すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll confirm the target and negative wording, hear the person's explanation, then repeat my own work scope back.
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will repeat the scope after the supervisor's explanation before working.

DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらで責任者の説明をお待ちください。確認後に作業指示を出します。
DLG-SC-TKY-CON-002-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait here for the supervisor's explanation. We'll give work instructions after confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物の移動をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I help you move your luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 袋に入れた自転車が改札に当たりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 輪行袋が改札幅に合わない懸念を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The bicycle in its bag looks as though it might hit the ticket gates.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Express in Japanese concern that your bicycle bag may not fit the gate width.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 行先とお持ちの券を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I check your destination and ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この駅へ乗り換えます。券はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 行先と券を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm transferring to this station. Here is my ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your destination and ticket in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの広い通路を確認します。同行者はいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check this wider passage. Are you with anyone?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一人です。袋を置いて離れずに通りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一人で荷物を管理して通りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm alone. I'd like to pass through while keeping hold of the bag, without leaving it unattended.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to pass through while managing your luggage alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 係員の案内で通れます。運ぶ時に手助けが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can pass with staff guidance. Do you need help carrying it?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持ち上げられますが、扉の前で止まりたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 運搬能力と扉前停止を避けたい希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can lift it, but don't want to stop in front of the door.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State your carrying ability and wish to avoid stopping before the door in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 右の待機場所で、先に通路の状態を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll first check the passage condition while you wait in the area on the right.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そこで待ちます。自転車を出して押すつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋を開けず指定位置で待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait there. I don't intend to take the bicycle out and push it.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait at the designated place without opening the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その袋のまま係員通路へご案内します。今は右側でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll guide you through the staffed passage with the bicycle in that bag. For now, wait on the right.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 休憩場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for somewhere to rest?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 海側では資料が飛びそうです。風の弱い所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 風で資料が飛ぶため休憩場所を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My papers might blow away on the sea side. Is there somewhere less windy?
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a rest area because the wind may blow away your papers.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 資料を広げて作業されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Will you spread out the papers to work?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いえ、しまって休みます。海の眺めは必須ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 資料をしまい眺望不要と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I'll put them away and rest. A sea view isn't essential.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will put the papers away and don't need a view.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 建物側のベンチをご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can show you benches on the building side.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そこへ行きたいです。落ちた紙だけ先に拾います。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 移動前に届く紙を拾うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to go there. I'll just pick up the fallen papers first.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will pick up papers within reach before moving.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 拾う時は通行と海側の境界に気を付けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: While picking them up, be careful of people passing and the boundary on the sea side.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 柵の外へ出ず、届かない紙は係へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 境界外へ出ず係へ相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't go outside the railing; I'll ask staff about papers I can't reach.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not cross the boundary and will consult staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 建物側へはこの道です。長く滞在されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: This is the way toward the building. Will you stay long?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 十分ほどです。休んだ後は駅側へ帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休憩時間と駅へ帰る予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: About ten minutes. After resting, I'll go back toward the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give your rest duration and plan to return to the station in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この道で建物側のベンチへどうぞ。駅へ戻る出口もその先です。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take this path to the benches by the building. The exit back to the station is farther along too.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お二人で入場されますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。でも友人だけ先に帰ります。別々に出られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別々の退場を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, but my friend will leave first. Can we exit separately?
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you would like to leave separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 券はそれぞれお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you each have your own ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一枚の画面に二人分あります。私の携帯です。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一端末の二人分券を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: There are tickets for two people on one screen, on my phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show in Japanese that two people's tickets are on one device.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 退場時の扱いを担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ask staff how separate departures are handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人に画像を渡すだけで足りるかも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 画像共有で足りるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please also check whether simply giving my friend an image is enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether sharing a ticket image is sufficient.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認前に画面のコピーで手続きを進めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Don't proceed using a screen copy before confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。友人は三時、私は四時に出る予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二人の退場予定時刻を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. My friend plans to leave at three, and I at four.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give both planned departure times in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別々の出口利用と券の提示方法を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll explain using exits separately and how to present the tickets.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人が出るまで携帯を私が持ち去らず、先に方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 方法確認前に券の端末を持ち去らない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't take the phone away before my friend leaves; I'll ask the method first.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not take away the ticket device before checking the method.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 入場前の相談として承りました。担当が二人分の提示と退場方法を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've accepted this as a pre-entry inquiry. Staff will explain presenting both tickets and how to exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 待ち合わせの方をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for people you're meeting?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 青い上着の団体ですが、二組あって迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 似た服装の二団体で迷ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's a group in blue jackets, but there are two groups and I'm unsure.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are confused by two similarly dressed groups.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相手から集合名や目印は聞いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did they give you a meeting name or landmark?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会社の交流会です。服の色しか聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 集合情報の不足を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's a company social gathering. I only heard the clothing color.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the missing meeting information in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 主催者にグループ名を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you check the group name with the organizer?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 連絡します。他の団体へついて行かず、ここで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 主催者へ確認し別団体について行かない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll contact them. I'll wait here rather than follow another group.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check with the organizer and not follow a different group.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路の外側でお待ちください。

DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返事が来ました。赤い旗の担当者に声を掛けるそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指定旗の返信を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've received a reply. It says to speak to the staff member with the red flag.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report the reply specifying a flag in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 旗のある場所はこちらです。お名前はそこで伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The flag is this way. Give your name there.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。団体名も確認してから合流します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 団体名を照合して合流する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll check the group name too before joining.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will match the group name before joining.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 赤い旗の受付へこの通路でどうぞ。青い服だけを目印にしないようご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take this passage to reception with the red flag. Please check rather than rely only on blue clothing.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。会社へ連絡したいのですが、受付時点で診断名は言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受付時点で診断名未確定と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like to contact my company, but at reception I can't give a diagnosis yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the diagnosis is not established at reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の症状と受診希望を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll ask about your present symptoms and wish to be seen.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日から咳があります。会社には受診予定とだけ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 咳の経過と会社への連絡内容を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've had a cough since yesterday. I'll tell the company only that I plan to see a doctor.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Separate the cough history from what you will tell your company in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付方法を案内します。勤務先から書類の指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll explain registration. Has your workplace specified a document?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受診したことの分かる書類が必要と言われました。名前は不明です。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 勤務先の書類要求と名称不明を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: They said they need something showing I attended a medical consultation. I don't know its name.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State your workplace's document request and the unknown name in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類の条件は勤務先にも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check the document conditions with your workplace.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 診断書と決めず、何を証明したいのか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 診断書を決めつけず証明目的を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Rather than assume a medical certificate, I'll ask what they need to certify.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the certification purpose rather than assume a diagnosis certificate.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受診後の発行については書類担当に相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can ask the document staff about issuance after being seen.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず初診受付を進め、会社の返事が来たら書類を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 初診を優先し書類は条件確認後に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll proceed with first-visit registration first, then ask about documents after my company replies.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will prioritize the initial visit and discuss documents after confirming requirements.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 初診の受付へご案内します。書類の相談と症状の診療を分けて引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll direct you to first-visit reception. We'll hand over the document inquiry separately from clinical care for your symptoms.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの書類についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which document would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 保険会社の紙です。ここの空欄を全部書いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 保険用紙の空欄記入を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: An insurance-company form. Could you fill in all these blank fields?
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about filling in blank fields on an insurance form.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 記入者の指定を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check who is designated to fill them in.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分で書く欄と証明を添える欄がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人記入欄と添付欄を読み分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: There are fields I fill in myself and fields requiring attached certification.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish applicant-completed fields from attachment fields in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な証明の名称は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you know the name of the required certificate?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。事故の届けの番号と、この添付指定を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 届出番号と証明指定を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. Please look at the accident report number and this attachment requirement.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the report number and specified certification in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 発行できる内容を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Staff will check what can be issued.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 保険金の判断までこちらに頼むつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保険判断を警察の証明と分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I don't intend to ask you to decide the insurance payment too.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the insurance decision from police certification in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 申請に必要な条件は保険会社へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the requirements for the claim with your insurance company.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では自分の記入欄を残し、証明の名称と発行方法を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 証明名称と発行方法に相談を絞る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll leave my own fields for myself and ask about the certificate name and issuance method.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Limit your inquiry in Japanese to the certificate name and how to obtain it.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 添付書類の相談として担当へおつなぎします。用紙全体はこちらで完成とはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll connect you to staff about the attachment. We won't treat the whole form as completed here.
